To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have designed an approach to auto-generate the implementation code of user operations on the persistent objects in a Web Information System.
the translation of typical user operations to concrete code in WISE is achieved through mapping template attributes to persistent data objects.
we have proposed a new framework for auto-generating the code of user operations in Web Information Systems.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following issues: (1) the definition of user operations, (2) the semantics of user operations, and (3) the mapping from user operations to concrete programming code.
the auto-construction of user operations.
the automatic construction of Web Information System, and the translation of user's operations on Web page to concrete data processing operations in persistent data sources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed approach can be used to automatically generate the code for user operations.
the WISE framework is an effective and efficient way for WIS auto-construction.
this paper provides the theoretical foundation for the implementation of WISE.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WIS is not only a data presentation system but also a user operation system.
the user operations can be translated to the corresponding code in persistent data source with the help of the mapping from the template attributes to the persistent objects.
we have provided a new approach for WIS development, and a new framework for the auto-construction of WIS.
The main takeaway from our work is that
user operations on a page can be expressed by a small set of operations on data objects.
the user operation is the core of a Web Information System, and it is possible to automatically construct a Web Information System by auto-construction of the operations.
the process of user operation can be separated from data presentation.
